en.headline: Police arrest 15 after Kwun Tong drug den raid
en.dek: Officers raided a unit on Shui Wo Street on Thursday, seizing suspected heroin, ice and other drugs with an estimated value of about HK$120,000; a 43-year-old woman was arrested for operating a drug den and trafficking.
body: Police arrested 15 people in Kwun Tong on Thursday after raiding a residential unit on Shui Wo Street suspected of being used as a drug den. Officers seized about 129.8 grams of suspected heroin, 9.5 grams of suspected ice, 36 suspected liquid etomidate capsules, 90 suspected midazolam pills and a quantity of drug-taking tools, with a total estimated street value of about HK$120,000.

A 43-year-old local woman was arrested on suspicion of operating a drug den and trafficking in dangerous drugs. Thirteen local men and one local woman aged between 26 and 75 were arrested on suspicion of taking or injecting dangerous drugs.

Police said the operation followed intelligence and investigation. All those arrested were being detained for further enquiries. Trafficking in dangerous drugs is a serious offence under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, carrying a maximum penalty of life imprisonment and a fine of HK$5 million.

zh.headline: 觀塘毒窟搜查 警拘15人檢約12萬元毒品
zh.dek: 警方周四在瑞和街一單位搜查，檢獲懷疑海洛英、冰毒等，市值約12萬元；一名43歲女子涉經營毒窟及販毒被捕。
body: 警方周四在觀塘瑞和街一個懷疑用作毒窟的住宅單位進行搜查，拘捕15人，檢獲約129.8克懷疑海洛英、9.5克懷疑冰毒、36粒懷疑液體依托咪酯膠囊、90粒懷疑咪達唑侖藥丸及一批吸毒工具，估計市值約12萬元。
一名43歲本地女子涉嫌經營毒窟及販運危險藥物被捕，另有13名本地男子及1名本地女子，年齡介乎26至75歲，涉嫌吸食或注射危險藥物被捕。
警方表示行動根據情報及調查展開，所有被捕人士現正被扣留調查。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，最高可判終身監禁及罰款500萬元。
